title: Piron at Pythian Temple and the Tulane collection
summary: They discuss the 1920 sheet music and a recording, and Leclerc admires the archive's collection including Sam Rosenbaum's manuscripts.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks
